errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the orange sector represents diesel vehicles when it actually represents gasoline vehicles.
The description assigns the yellow sector to hybrid vehicles, while in the figure it is the brown sector.
The description does not mention the purpose of the chart, which is to show the distribution of registered vehicles by fuel type in Bulgaria.
